definitions.explanation: Indicates the country of manufacture or the material something is made from.

examples.japanese: これは{日本|にほん}{製|せい}の{車|くるま}です。
examples.english: This is a car made in Japan.

examples.japanese: {外国|がいこく}{製|せい}の{家具|かぐ}を{買|か}った。
この{机|つくえ}は{木|き}{製|せい}で、とても{丈夫|じょうぶ}だ。
examples.english: This desk is made of wood and very sturdy.

notes:
～{製|せい} attaches to nouns indicating either the country/company of manufacture or the material used.

COUNTRY/MAKER:
- {日本|にほん}{製|せい}: made in Japan
- {外国|がいこく}{製|せい}: foreign-made
- {国産|こくさん}: domestically made (alternative)
- {自社|じしゃ}{製|せい}: in-house made

MATERIAL:
- {木|き}{製|せい}: made of wood
- {金属|きんぞく}{製|せい}: made of metal
- {革|かわ}{製|せい}: made of leather
- プラスチック{製|せい}: made of plastic

OTHER:
- {手|て}{製|せい}: handmade
- {特注|とくちゅう}{製|せい}: custom-made

NOTE:
Often appears on product labels: 〇〇{製|せい}。
